cards.name: Whirlpool
cards.summary: Bitmap distortion that fills the image with many small swirling eddies spaced across it, smearing the pixels into curling fluid streaks so the picture looks stirred like marbled ink or a liquid painting. Spacing sets how far apart the eddies sit, Twist how tightly each one curls, Smear Length and Streak Detail how long and how textured the streaks are, and Warp also bends the underlying image along the flow.
use_for: psychedelic or marbled-ink poster backgrounds
turning a dull photo into an abstract painterly texture
dreamy / surreal transition plates and album-cover art
liquid-swirl fill for a text clipping mask
avoid: faces and readable text: the eddies destroy detail, mask the effect off people and type
a single big spiral around one centre: this spreads many small eddies over the whole image; for one spiral use Effects/Distort/Swirl
tiny Spacing on a large bitmap: the swirls shrink to noise at gallery size, raise Spacing so each eddy is visible

params.name: Spacing
params.does: distance between the eddies; small = many small swirls, large = fewer, bigger swirls

params.name: Smear Length
params.does: how far each pixel is dragged along the flow; longer = stretched streaks

params.name: Twist
params.does: how tightly the flow curls inside each eddy; 0 = almost straight flow, 90 = tight spirals

params.name: Streak Detail
params.does: how much fine streak texture shows inside the smear

params.name: Warp
params.does: on: the image itself is bent along the swirl field as well as smeared; off: smear only

params.name: Presets
params.does: dialog presets that load a set of the sliders above (Default, Brush Strokes, Crystallize)

pairs_with: a saturation boost before it, for more colourful marbling
PowerClip to confine the swirl to text or a shape
Transparency over the original bitmap to dial the effect back
cards.scripting: shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect "Whirlpool", "WhirlpoolEffect Spacing=50,Warp=1,SmearLength=20,Twist=80,StreakDetail=80"  (shape must be a bitmap; cmd_template from the harvest; the format is proven on 6 other effects but this effect's string was not test-applied, and how a bool is written (1 vs true) is unconfirmed). Menu route: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "e0179dd3-453d-4046-b70f-f14fb390aa00" opens the dialog.
cards.non_destructive: From the menu it is a non-destructive effect in CorelDRAW 2024 (listed in the Properties docker effect stack, toggle EffectsPropertiesDS ApplyOrDeleteEffect:WhirlpoolEffect) and works on vector objects too; the harvest does not say whether the scripted Shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect path bakes into the pixels.
cards.cost: moderate to heavy: per-pixel flow simulation, slows on large or high-dpi bitmaps

review.changes: avoid: named CorelDRAW's own single-spiral effect (Effects/Distort/Swirl) instead of a vague 'twirl-type distortion'; scripting: noted the shape must be a bitmap.

verified.note: Re-rendered with 'Smear Length': the whole plate is covered with small swirling eddies that curl the wall, dark areas and swatches into marbled, fluid streaks while the scene stays readable; the 'dropped' list is not evidence, because Whirlpool is random and its repeat-render noise (11) equals every key probe (live chain trap).

cards.name: Wind
cards.summary: Bitmap effect that drags pixels into fine streaks in one direction, as if a strong wind were blowing across the image: edges and bright areas trail streaky smears along the chosen Angle. Strength sets how long and intense the streaks are and Opacity how much of the streaked result shows over the original.
use_for: speed / motion streaks behind a product or sports subject
wind-blown, stormy look on a poster background
streaked text-effect plates (from the menu it applies straight to text and vectors; convert to bitmap only for the scripted route)
gritty directional texture for action or sale banners
avoid: smooth camera-style motion blur: Wind leaves streaky trails, not an even blur
readable small text and faces: the streaks smear them, mask them out
when it barely shows on an already soft photo: push Strength to the top and keep Opacity at 100

params.name: Strength
params.does: length and intensity of the wind streaks

params.name: Opacity
params.does: how visible the streaked result is over the original (100 = full effect)

params.name: Angle
params.does: direction the wind blows, in degrees on a compass wheel (5 degree steps)

pairs_with: a second Wind pass at the opposite Angle for a blast look
Transparency or a mask to keep the subject's front edge crisp
Effects > Blur > Motion Blur for a smoother speed trail under the streaks
cards.scripting: shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect "Wind", "WindEffect Strength=100,Opacity=100,Angle=0"  (shape must be a bitmap; cmd_template from the harvest; the format is proven on 6 other effects but this effect's string was not test-applied). Menu route: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "6d702802-b30d-4f56-ab4a-2ce406972c31" opens the dialog.
cards.non_destructive: From the menu it is a non-destructive effect in CorelDRAW 2024 (Properties docker effect stack, toggle EffectsPropertiesDS ApplyOrDeleteEffect:WindEffect) and works on vector objects too; the harvest does not say whether the scripted Shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect path bakes into the pixels.

review.changes: use_for: dropped 'apply to text converted to bitmap', which contradicts the batch (menu route works on vector objects); scripting: noted the shape must be a bitmap.

verified.note: Fine horizontal streaks trail across the plate (Angle 0), most visible on the bright wall, mid-tones, stripes and the green and magenta swatches: a light windswept smear; Strength and Opacity are listed as dropped, but Wind is random (repeat-render noise 3.0 vs probes 2.7-2.8), so that list cannot be trusted.

cards.name: Artistic Media
cards.summary: Opens the Artistic Media docker, the library of brush and sprayer strokes used by the Artistic Media tool (stroke folders such as Artistic, Calligraphy Brush, Splash_Splatter, Plants); clicking a stroke applies it to the selected path, either as a shaped brush stroke stretched along the path or as a sprayer that scatters objects along it. The stroke stays linked to the control path, so reshaping the path reshapes the stroke.
use_for: hand-drawn / brush-lettered headline strokes
decorative swashes, borders and dividers along a curve
scattering leaves, stars or confetti along a path (sprayer)
tapered calligraphic outlines for logos and illustrations
avoid: when nothing is selected or the object has no path to follow: draw or select a curve first
very long or complex paths with sprayer strokes: object count and redraw time balloon
files going to apps that need plain strokes: use Object/Break Apart (or convert to curves) before export
pairs_with: Freehand / Bezier / Pen tools to draw the control path
the Artistic Media tool (Toolbox/Drawing Tools/Artistic Media) for its Calligraphic and Expression modes and for drawing strokes directly
Object/Break Apart to detach the stroke from its control path for editing
cards.scripting: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "5fc0becf-f73a-442b-81d6-3089e17ab44c" only toggles the Artistic Media docker (docker e79e3cf2-c93d-4694-b463-f2f7113872e8); choosing a stroke and applying it happens in the docker. The harvest records no object-model call that applies a chosen stroke.
cards.non_destructive: yes: the stroke is a live effect bound to the control path until broken apart
cards.cost: light for preset / brush strokes; heavier for sprayer strokes with many objects

review.changes: summary: the docker is the brush / sprayer stroke library, not the tool's Calligraphic and 'pressure' modes (that mode is called Expression in this version and lives on the tool's property bar); 'Break Artistic Media Apart' is not a harvested command, replaced with Object/Break Apart in avoid and pairs_with.

verified.note: Listed in gallery/cdr_effect/not_rendered.json (status 'needs_input' (only current cards are rendered)), so there is no frame to check.

second_opinion.note: Agree: listed in not_rendered.json by rule (status needs_input); harness check: no render was attempted, so there is no frame to misread and the card makes no frame-based claim.

cards.name: Bevel
cards.summary: Opens the Bevel docker, which gives a filled vector object a lit, raised edge: Soft Edge bevels the rim (to an offset or all the way to the centre) with highlight and shadow from a light source, Emboss makes the object look pressed out of the surface. From a script, Shape.CreateCustomEffect('Bevel', ...) with the nine values as separate arguments renders it (2026-10-13 gallery: a soft-edge rim lit from the upper left on the vector plate's star). Per the harvested object model the settings are bevel type, mode (centre or offset), offset, light colour, intensity, direction and altitude, shadow colour and ambient intensity.
use_for: raised button and badge graphics
embossed logo or seal on a coloured background
chunky headline type with a lit edge
quick plastic / metal plaque look without a 3D tool
avoid: open paths or objects without a fill: the bevel follows the filled area
photoreal 3D depth: this is a flat lit-edge illusion, use an extrude for real depth

scripting with fewer than the nine values: CreateCustomEffect('Bevel', ...) is a ParamArray call; with only Type / Mode / Offset the lights stay off and the shape renders black, a list passed as one argument raises DISP_E_BADPARAMCOUNT, and the bevel cannot be edited after creation (IEffectBevel setters raise 'The referenced object no longer exists')

Type 0 (Soft Edge) on an object with a gradient fill: it flattens the fill to grey, while Type 1 (Emboss) keeps the gradient; use Emboss on gold or chrome style fountain fills (plan runs 2026-10-15 (text_effects.gold_metallic, text_effects.chrome))
pairs_with: a solid or gradient fill on the object (the lighting reads best on mid-tone colour)
Drop Shadow for lift off the page
cards.scripting: shape.CreateCustomEffect('Bevel', 0, 1, 0.3, light_color, 100, 135.0, 45.0, shadow_color, 50)  # Type 0 = cdrBevelSoftEdge (turns a gradient fill flat grey), Type 1 = Emboss (keeps it), Mode 1 = cdrBevelOffset, Offset 0.3 (document unit, inch here), then LightColor, LightIntensity, LightDirection, LightAltitude, ShadowColor, AmbientIntensity, each a separate argument; the colours are RGB Color objects (white and black in the gallery). Rendered by the 2026-10-13 gallery; only Type / Mode / Offset read back through Effect.Custom (the light values read back as garbage, so they are sent, not verified). FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "91062f47-0342-43a3-827b-ed78815cfce5" only toggles the Bevel docker (docker 370e97bf-651f-4431-9bfd-140035be0c7e).
cards.non_destructive: yes: a live effect on the object (readable as Effect.Custom) that can be edited or cleared

verified.note: New frame (CreateCustomEffect, Type soft edge, Mode offset 0.3 in, light 135 / 45): the blue star carries a bevelled rim, lighter facets on its upper-left edges and dark facets on the lower right with the face slightly darker blue, a lit soft-edge bevel as the card describes; the other shapes are untouched; scripting and avoid updated to the working route.

previous.note: No frame: failed.json says "no scripted apply path: the harvest has no cdr_com / effect_id for this item, only ['cdr_guid'] (the Effects menu entry toggles a docker); creation call not established: VGCoreAuto.tlb has no CreateBevel; [...]"; harness, not the effect: no working scripted route was found, so the effect itself is untested; renderer: Shape.CreateCustomEffect(EffectID, Parameters) needs the bevel EffectID, not probed (no CreateBevel in the typelib).

second_opinion.note: Harness check: no frame exists, failed.json names the scripted route (every command form tried), not the effect, so 'broken' here means the render broke; the card text hedges the script route and makes no look claim from a frame. Shape.CreateCustomEffect with the bevel EffectID is an unprobed route, so rerender stays true; status stays current.

cards.name: PhotoCocktail
cards.summary: Opens the PhotoCocktail docker, which builds a photo mosaic: the selected source image is recreated from a grid of many small photos taken from a folder or collection you supply, each tile chosen and tinted to match the colour of that area. Up close you see individual photos, from a distance the source picture.
use_for: photo-mosaic posters made from event or team photos
anniversary / tribute collages that form a portrait or logo
campaign visuals built from user-submitted photos
avoid: running it without a folder of tile photos: it needs that second input
small output sizes: the tiles become unreadable dots, so it pays off on large prints
heavy files: hundreds of embedded bitmaps bloat the document, flatten or export when final
pairs_with: a high-contrast, simple source image (portrait or logo) so the mosaic still reads
File > Export to a flat bitmap once the mosaic is final
cards.scripting: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "03687a21-eb94-d8a8-4fe6-a2c8b5251210" only toggles the PhotoCocktail docker (docker d38b764b-2616-7bab-437b-2233d902aec5); picking the tile photos and building the mosaic happen in the docker. The batch records no object-model call; the cdr_api harvest does list the docker's data-source interface IPhotoCocktailDataSource (PhotoCocktail.tlb, with OnSelectImagePool / OnApply), but how a script reaches that data source was not established or tested.
cards.non_destructive: generates new objects for the mosaic; the docker's data source has a KeepOriginal setting (cdr_api harvest), so the source can be kept; the harvest does not say whether the mosaic stays editable as one effect
cards.cost: heavy: many bitmap tiles, large file size and slow redraw

review.changes: scripting: 'the harvest records no object-model call' was too strong; the cdr_api harvest has IPhotoCocktailDataSource with OnApply, now named with the caveat that reaching it from a script is unproven; non_destructive: cites the KeepOriginal setting instead of asserting the source is untouched.

verified.note: Listed in gallery/cdr_effect/not_rendered.json (status 'needs_input' (only current cards are rendered)), so there is no frame to check.

second_opinion.note: Agree: listed in not_rendered.json by rule (status needs_input); harness check: no render was attempted, so there is no frame to misread and the card makes no frame-based claim.

cards.name: Pointillizer
cards.summary: Opens the Pointillizer docker, which turns the selected bitmap or vector objects into a vector mosaic of many small dots (or other tile shapes), each coloured from the artwork beneath it, giving a pointillist / dot-art version that stays fully vector and scales cleanly.
use_for: pointillist or dot-art posters from a photo
vector mosaic logos and portraits for large-format print, signage or vinyl cutting
halftone-style dot backgrounds that stay editable as vectors
avoid: fine detail and small text: dots wipe them out, keep them as separate objects on top
very high dot density on large areas: thousands of objects make the file slow, lower the density
a raster pointillist look on a photo where vector output is not needed: the bitmap effect Effects/Art Strokes/Pointillist is lighter

scripts: the 2026-10-13 gallery render found no working scripted call (no scripted apply path: the harvest has no cdr_com / effect_id for this item, only ['cdr_guid'] (the Effects menu entry toggles a docker);); apply it from the menu, dialog or docker
pairs_with: a dark or solid background behind the dots
Edit > Find and Replace to recolour the generated dots by colour
cards.scripting: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "d509273d-5975-4481-a6a2-e4351cd7bbd6" only toggles the Pointillizer docker (docker 899d052c-fc8b-93b0-43c7-bda85ca8f417); dot settings and Apply happen in the docker. The harvest records no object-model call for it.
cards.non_destructive: generates a new set of vector dots from the selection instead of editing it in place; the harvest does not say whether the result stays a live effect
cards.cost: moderate to heavy, depends on the number of dots generated

review.changes: equivalents.AI: Effect/Pixelate/Pointillize is a raster Photoshop effect; Illustrator's vector-mosaic counterpart is Object/Create Object Mosaic... (square tiles only); PS Pointillize kept as the nearest dot look (raster). avoid: named CorelDRAW's raster alternative Effects/Art Strokes/Pointillist.

verified.note: No frame: failed.json says "no scripted apply path: the harvest has no cdr_com / effect_id for this item, only ['cdr_guid'] (the Effects menu entry toggles a docker);"; the Effects-menu entry only toggles a docker and the harvest has no creation call; harness, not the effect: no working scripted route was found, so the effect itself is untested; status set to needs_input.

second_opinion.note: Harness check: no frame exists, failed.json names the scripted route (every command form tried), not the effect, so 'broken' here means the render broke; the card text hedges the script route and makes no look claim from a frame. Every listed form (and the object-model twin where one exists) changed nothing, and the demo values are far from a no-op, so needs_input is the honest status, matching Selective Color / Tone Curve.
